fact: The Ministry of Health's Annuaire statistique 2024, published April 2025 (figures cover 2024), states its data come from the monthly activity reports of public and private health facilities, entered in the Endos-BF health data warehouse and validated by districts, regions and the ministry's statistics directorate.

The yearbook says it follows previous editions and that the yearbook for year n-1 must be available by June of year n, with the 2024 edition (published April 2025) on time; this is a stated annual series.
